parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
Language type of the returned message:

- zh: Chinese
- en: English

parameters.name: DataIds
parameters.description: Configuration items to be cloned, in the format of dataId+group, with multiple items separated by commas.

parameters.name: Policy
parameters.description:
The strategy used when a write conflict occurs.

- ABORT
- SKIP
- OVERWRITE
